 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Pakistan will aim to maintain their perfect run ahead of the final of the ODI Tri-Series when they face Sri Lanka in Lahore on Tuesday.
 With three wins thus far -- victories over Sri Lanka by 37 runs and over England by 87 runs followed by their one-wicket triumph over England in a tough chase -- the hosts have already qualified for the October 31 final.

 On the other hand, hoping to qualify for the final against Pakistan, Sri Lanka will look to build on their stunning two-wicket win over England chasing 430.
 After gaining two points from two matches, the October 27 encounter at Lahore is therefore vital for the Lankans as they try to make it two wins from two matches before facing England on October 29.
 In this article, The Sporting News takes you through all the details related to how and where to watch the Pakistan vs. Sri Lanka ODI.

 Pakistan vs. Sri Lanka ODI live stream, TV channel 
 Here's how to watch the Pakistan vs. Sri Lanka ODI in India:
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement TV channel: N/A
 Live stream: Veto App.
 The Pakistan ODI Tri-Series 2026 is not being telecast in India. However, live streaming options are available on Veto App , which is currently free of cost and does not require subscription.
 MORE: Visit Cricket News for all the latest cricket coverage and opinion 
 What time does Pakistan vs. Sri Lanka ODI start?
 The fourth match of the Pakistan ODI Tri-Series between Pakistan and Sri Lanka will be played at Gaddafi Stadium in Lahore, Pakistan.
 It is scheduled to start at 1:00 p.m. local time (PKT), which translates to 1:30 p.m. IST on Tuesday, October 27 , for viewers in India .

 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Pakistan vs. Sri Lanka ODI team news, lineups
 Shaheen Shah Afridi's side have qualified for the final after winning their first three matches. Babar Azam, Fakhar Zaman and Saim Ayub lead the batting, while Pakistan could consider rotating their bowling attack.
 Pakistan predicted XI: Saim Ayub, Fakhar Zaman, Babar Azam, Salman Ali Agha, Hasan Nawaz, Shadab Khan, Faheem Ashraf, Muhammad Ghazi Ghori, Shaheen Shah Afridi, Haris Rauf, Abrar Ahmed.
 Kusal Mendis captains the visiting side as they look to build on their win over England. Wanindu Hasaranga is out injured, with Pathum Nissanka, Kamindu Mendis and Dasun Shanaka key players.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Sri Lanka predicted XI: Pathum Nissanka, Kamil Mishara, Avishka Fernando, Kusal Mendis, Kamindu Mendis, Pavan Rathnayake, Dasun Shanaka, Dunith Wellalage, Maheesh Theekshana, Dushmantha Chameera, Asitha Fernando.
